Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface SuffixOutput<I,D> extends Output<I,D>
Feature for transition systems that compute a suffix-observable output function, i.e., they compute an output containing a part that can be attributed to a suffix of the input.

Note that this is a special case of the Output feature, as computeOutput(input) = computeSuffixOutput(ε, input).
